equity_bridge.item: Interim dividend INR 26/share paid 11 Nov 2026, after the balance sheet date
equity_bridge.note: Q2 FY2027 IFRS financials: 'net cash outflow of approximately INR 10,531 crore ($1,099 million)'. Record date 3 Nov 2026, so the quoted price is ex-dividend.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (-1.3% over 5 years) diverges by far more than 30% from revenue (8.2%) and EPS (5.6%). Book value is not a growth signal here: Infosys returns 85%+ of FCF (114% in FY2026 with the buyback), so equity is flat by policy. Revenue 3-year CAGR is used instead.
historical_growth.notes: All in USD, FY2026 (March 2026) end year. FCF CAGRs are on owner FCF = reported FCF less SBC less interest and dividend income (FY2021 2,851; FY2023 2,331; FY2026 3,498), before the lease deduction, which is not available consistently pre-FY2020. The 3-year figure is flattered by a weak FY2023 base (working-capital build) and a low FY2026 cash tax; the 5-year 4.2% is the better read. SBC is 0.5% of revenue and stable, so owner and reported FCF growth are effectively the same. USD growth understates INR growth by the rupee's depreciation (~3%/yr).

scenario_narratives.base: FY2027 lands inside the cut 1-2% constant-currency guide. Large-deal TCV (62% net new in Q2 FY2027) converts to revenue and discretionary budgets in Retail, Hi-Tech and Manufacturing recover, taking USD growth back to 4.5-5% by FY2030 before fading to 3%. AI is roughly a wash: AI-first work (10.5% of revenue and rising) replaces application-maintenance and BPM volume that is repriced for productivity. Operating margin stays at the 21% midpoint of the 20-22% band through the CEO handover to Ashiss Kumar Dash in April 2027. Tax at 28% as SEZ benefits roll off.
scenario_narratives.bull: Infosys becomes a net beneficiary of enterprise AI adoption: Topaz and agentic deployment work grow faster than legacy lines deflate, the 90% of top-200 clients already engaged on AI expand scope, and Energy/Utilities, Life Sciences and Communications keep taking share. Growth returns to 7-8% for three years, the level of FY2018-FY2020 rather than the FY2022 peak. Operating margin drifts to the 22% top of the band on offshore mix (77%+), utilisation and platform revenue. The DOJ investigation and the Cognizant suit close without material cash.
scenario_narratives.bear: AI substitutes for labour-based development, maintenance and BPM faster than Infosys can replace it, and clients take the productivity as price cuts or move work into their own capability centres. Revenue shrinks in FY2029-FY2030 and then grows only 1-2%. The US$100,000 H-1B fee, the PERM suspension and local hiring push onsite costs up, and a DOJ settlement adds a one-off; operating margin falls to 18%, two points below the bottom of today's band. SEZ expiry takes the tax rate to 30%. The business remains strongly cash generative; this is erosion, not distress.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Infosys is valued as a mature, net-cash, capital-light services franchise on lease-adjusted owner FCF in USD, converted to INR at spot. SBC is immaterial (0.5% of revenue), so house and street values sit within a few percent of each other and the valuation turns almost entirely on two things: whether USD revenue growth recovers to mid single digits or AI deflates the labour-based core, and whether the 20-22% operating margin band holds. Investment income is stripped from the flows and the cash pile is added once, net of the interim dividend already paid.
key_risks_to_valuation: AI-driven price deflation in application development, maintenance and BPM: each 1pp of operating margin is worth about 5% of value
USD/INR: per-share value in INR moves one-for-one with the spot rate, and refresh_price does not update fx_rate; a weaker rupee also lifts margins, which the model does not credit
US immigration policy and the DOJ H-1B classification investigation: unquantified, carried only in the bear weight
Terminal value is roughly half of enterprise value at a 9.5% USD discount rate; see the sensitivity grid
Cash tax: the model uses 28% against 21.6% actually paid in FY2026; SEZ expiry could push the rate above 28%
CEO transition in April 2027 after eight years under Salil Parekh

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 980.4-1728.0 INR. FX from Yahoo USDINR=X, see inputs.fx_note.
data_sources.financials: INFY.NS_Metrics.csv and INFY.NS.duckdb (USD millions, IFRS); FY2026 20-F consolidated cash flow statement and notes; Q2 FY2027 IFRS USD condensed consolidated financial statements and press release (balance sheet 30 Sep 2026, cash and investments, diluted shares, lease and ROU movements, interim dividend).
data_sources.qualitative: INFY.NS_Analysis.json dated 2026-11-14 (guidance, AI revenue mix, regulatory and litigation items).

inputs.share_count_basis: Diluted weighted-average shares for the quarter ended 30 Sep 2026 (4,054,326,796; Q2 FY2027 IFRS income statement note 2.13). No buyback or issuance in H1 FY2027, so the quarter average is the period-end diluted count. Held FLAT because SBC is expensed in the flows.
inputs.cash_note: Company-defined 'consolidated cash and investments' at 30 Sep 2026: cash and equivalents 2,541 + current investments 1,436 + non-current liquid investments, excluding equity/preference investments and CCDs. No borrowings. Lease liabilities (890 at 30 Sep 2026) are EXCLUDED from net debt because lease cash is charged in the flows (treatment B).
inputs.reported_fcf_note: FY2026 company-defined FCF is 3,733 (OCF 4,039 less capex 306). The 3,415 here is that figure less 318 of lease-liability payments (financing activities), so that last_fcf is lease-adjusted owner FCF under treatment B. 3,415 - 108 SBC - 178 interest inside OCF = 3,129.
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2026 income from financial assets was 349 (184 amortized-cost interest + 121 FVOCI interest + 44 gains). The cash flow statement already removes 127 of 'interest and dividend income' from OCF (received in investing), so about 178 of interest on deposits remains inside OCF; that is the amount stripped. Net cash is 1.5x the FCF base, so the strip is required. The forward flows are built from operating EBITDA and carry no investment income at all.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 20-F consolidated cash flow statement, 'Stock compensation expense' 108 (H1 FY2027: 48). No separate equity-award withholding-tax line is disclosed; Indian RSU settlement does not use US-style net-share withholding.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2026 tender buyback of INR 18,000 crore at INR 1,800/share (cash flow statement, financing). None in FY2024, FY2025 or H1 FY2027. Infosys is a real repurchaser: the diluted count fell from 4,571m (FY2014) to 4,054m, so the flat count is funded, not a convention.
inputs.fx_note: USD/INR 94.24, Yahoo Finance USDINR=X at 2026-11-13 (model USD x 94.24 = INR per share). Parity check against the NYSE ADS (1 ADS = 1 share): NSE price / 94.24 = US$12.11 vs INFY ADS US$12.29, a 1.5% ADS premium, which is the normal sign and size. Statements used are the IFRS USD consolidated financials (20-F and quarterly 6-K); the INR Ind-AS set is the same business translated.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-11-13T09:58:12Z NSE regular session (Yahoo Finance chart API)
inputs.wacc_rationale: 9.5%, built in USD because the flows are USD-reported and ~87% of revenue is North America and Europe. US 10-year ~4.3% + beta ~0.85 x 5.0% ERP = ~8.6% cost of equity, plus ~0.9pp for Indian domicile and the INR cost base. No debt, so WACC = cost of equity. The same rate is used in all three scenarios; risk is carried in the flows and the weights, not in the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment B (leases as operating cost). Lease cash is charged in the flows via lease_cost_pct_path at 1.7% of revenue (FY2026 payment of lease liabilities 318 = 1.58%; H1 FY2027 191 = 1.87% annualised). Lease liabilities are excluded from net debt. D&A in the tax build is ex right-of-use depreciation: FY2026 D&A 552 less ROU depreciation ~188 (H1 FY2027: 94) = ~1.75% of revenue.
inputs.nci_treatment: Ignored: non-controlling interests take ~2-4 of ~3,300 net profit (0.1%) and carry 56 of equity.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF, component route, with the non-US adaptations (dual currency USD statements / INR quote, IFRS 16 leases, strip of investment income). Routed as an ordinary operating company (IT services); first valuation of this ticker. 10-year horizon to give the AI transition room to play out in growth, although margins are already mature. adj EBITDA margin in the paths is IFRS-16 EBITDA before SBC: H1 FY2027 operating margin 21.0% + D&A 2.7% + SBC 0.5% = 24.2%; FY2026 was 23.5% on a 20.3% operating margin. The 30 Sep 2026 cash balance is before the INR 26 interim dividend paid 11 Nov 2026 (US$1,099m per the company); the price is ex-dividend, so that cash is removed in equity_bridge. Y1 is FY2027 (year to 31 March 2027) discounted a full period although seven and a half months have elapsed; that is the house end-of-year convention and is mildly conservative. Open items not modelled as cash: DOJ H-1B classification investigation and the Cognizant/TriZetto suit (no provision quantified); they sit in the bear weight.

base.growth_rationale: Y1 is FY2027: guidance 1-2% constant currency, H1 reported USD growth 2.1% including acquisitions. Recovery to 4.5-5% as $14.9bn FY2026 and $8.8bn H1 FY2027 large-deal TCV converts and discretionary spend normalises, then fade. Ten-year average 3.8% against a 3-year actual of 3.4% and a 5-year of 8.2%.
base.margin_rationale: Operating margin held at 21.0%, the midpoint of the 20-22% band management has kept through two guidance cuts. No expansion assumed: AI productivity pass-through and visa costs offset utilisation and offshore-mix gains.
base.tax_rationale: 28%: effective rate 26.4% (FY2026, helped by provision reversals), 28.9% (FY2025), 29.3% (H1 FY2027). Cash tax paid ran lower (FY2026 973 = 21.6% of pre-tax, FY2025 662 with refunds) and is not treated as repeatable.
base.wc_rationale: Negative: a services business funds receivables and unbilled revenue as it grows. FY2026 net working-capital outflow 259 on 881 of revenue growth (-29%); FY2025 -70 on 715 (-10%).

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Moved from the 15/50/35 house default to 25/50/25. Bear raised to 25%: guidance has been cut twice in two quarters, AI is a direct substitute for the bulk of current revenue, and the DOJ H-1B investigation is unresolved in the market that supplies 55% of revenue. Base at 50%: it only requires guidance to hold and deal wins to convert at a margin management has defended for years. Bull cut to 25%: it needs AI to be net additive, discretionary spend to recover and US immigration policy to stop tightening, three largely independent things.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
